text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text: And now, for the face of the past four seasons! Our Umamusume of the Year…

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text: Holding a firm grip on the lead, she astounded us with a number of spectacular getaways. Everyone, give it up for Silence Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, Taiki Shuttle wasn't able to achieve her dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But her overwhelming power and speed have certainly captivated the hearts of many fans as the fastest sprinter around.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our first three years together have passed by, just like that…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Sorry for being so tardy! By the time I realized it, my feet were takin' me to the racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I was so sure I'd get Umamusume of the Year this time around, but I guess I went overboard with everything!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Trainer, our time together has flown right by. Just as fast as me down the track!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: The two of us have accomplished so much. My family's pleased as punch too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Were you happy bein' by my side, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yay! I was hoping you'd say that.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I might not've become Umamusume of the Year yet, but I ain't finished trying!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna keep on runnin' and making people happy!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Thanks for everything, Trainer! I'm lookin' forward to what the future's got in store for us!
